description: This file defines an AdminController class responsible for handling administrative operations in a Spring Boot backend. It provides endpoints for admins to retrieve all orders, update order status, and get all users, using RESTful mappings and security annotations.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: REST controller for admin-specific operations, secured with role-based access, providing endpoints to manage orders and users.

methods.name: getAllOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all orders in the system.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific order identified by ID.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all users in the system.
